reviews.text: Nice colour, I use it with a lip gloss so that my lips would not look dry. This lipstick is like a colour giving thing, but mandatory (for me) to use with something more moisturising. I apply it to my hand first, and then blend it on my lips.
reviews.zh: 顏色好好，我會配唇彩一齊用，令嘴唇唔會睇落乾燥。呢支唇膏好似純粹用嚟上色咁，不過（對我嚟講）一定要配一啲保濕啲嘅產品一齊用。我會先喺手上塗，然後再推勻喺唇上。

reviews.text: Formulation is fine - swipes on nicely. Doesn’t last as long as I would like, but maybe that’s too be expected for a lipstick. The color is amazing. It’s a great MLBB for someone like me who’s overall neutral (cool undertones, warm overtones, potential Winter cool?) and pink/purple natural lips. It feels a bit more natural than Charlotte Tilbury’s pillow talk (see photo for comparison).
reviews.zh: 配方幾好，搽得好順。持久力唔及我想像中咁長，不過對唇膏嚟講，可能都係正常。顏色好正。對於我呢類整體膚色中性（冷底調、暖表調，可能係 Winter cool？）同粉紫色天然唇色嘅人嚟講，係一個好好嘅 MLBB。比起 Charlotte Tilbury 嘅 pillow talk，佢感覺自然啲（睇相比較）。

reviews.text: Very impressed with this lipstick! I don't wear matte lipsticks because they usually dry out my lips, but this one did not. Beautiful pigment and doesn't migrate into the lines around my lips. I will be buying more!
reviews.zh: 對呢支唇膏好印象深刻！我平時唔太用啞光唇膏，因為佢哋通常會令我嘅嘴唇乾燥，但係呢支就冇。色素好靚，亦唔會滲入嘴唇周圍嘅紋路。我會再買！

reviews.text: A cor mais sexy e misteriosa dessa coleção, como o nome ja diz "midnight". É um vermelho escuro com um fundo azul presente, perfeito para a noite e um look super misterioso! Ele transfere um pouco até secar, marca as peles secas da boca se não tiver a hidratação em dia, mas a durabilidade da fixação é incrível
reviews.zh: 呢個系列入面最性感同最神秘嘅色，正如個名「midnight」所講。係深紅色，帶有藍色底，好啱夜晚用，效果超級神秘！佢乾咗之前會稍為過色，如果嘴唇冇做足保濕，會突顯出乾燥嘅唇紋，不過佢嘅定色力好強。

reviews.text: I have never tried romand zero matte lipstick before, I have been observing them for three years now. I wanted to try it when a colour this mute and romantic comes out. I wish the packaging of this cooler toned lipstick has different colour than the warm toned lipstick. So I can differentiate them.
reviews.zh: 我之前從來未試過 romand zero matte 唇膏，我觀察咗佢哋三年。我係見到呢個咁柔和、浪漫嘅色推出，先想試吓。我希望冷色調嗰款唇膏嘅包裝，可以用唔同顏色，同暖色調嗰款分得開。

reviews.text:
Really pretty lipstick that is actually my natural lip color. I have light medium tan skin so it was really nice to find a shade that naturally fits me! The matte is really nice and it applies sooo smoothly while having a powder like texture. Would definitely recommend to watch videos like Minsco so that you are able to see the different colors when applied! I swatched it with three different intensities: 1: dabbed the lipstick so that it’s is a light color 2: one swatch with slight pressure 3: 2-3 coats 
Note that it looks a bit different in different lighting too!
reviews.zh:
好靚嘅唇膏，其實就係我嘅天然唇色。我嘅膚色係淺至中等偏啡，所以搵到一個自然啱我嘅色，真係好開心！啞光效果好好，推得好順，質地好似粉末咁。一定推薦你睇吓 Minsco 之類嘅影片，咁你就可以見到搽咗之後嘅唔同色調！我試咗三種深淺：1：用唇膏輕點，令顏色淺啲；2：一次輕微用力塗；3：塗兩至三層。
注意，喺唔同燈光下，睇落都會有少少唔同！

reviews.text:
한번쓰고 선물했어요
텍스쳐 비추
난감하게 안발려요
뭐지이거... 별로에요 돈아까움
각질많은입술도아닌데 이건아닌듯ㅠㅠ

用咗一次就送咗畀人
質地唔好
好難搽，搽唔開
呢個係咩嚟嘅…… 唔好，浪費錢
又唔係死皮好多嘅嘴唇，但係呢款好似唔啱ㅠㅠ

reviews.text: This matte lipstick is not drying at all. However the downside is that you CANNOT have chapped lips. Any dead skin on your lips will clump up and look 100x worse after applying the lipstick. Make sure to exfoliate before. Got mine in Shell nude - I use it as a base colour together with other lipsticks to create a gradient.
reviews.zh: 呢款啞光唇膏完全唔會乾燥。不過缺點係，你嘅嘴唇唔可以乾裂。嘴唇上面任何死皮，搽咗唇膏之後都會結成一嚿，睇落差劣百倍。搽之前一定要去角。我買咗 Shell nude 色，我會用佢做底色，再配搭其他唇膏做漸層效果。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
